examples.text: Jeszcze musze sprawdzic, czy bedzie banglać, ale właśnie nie moge znaleźć narzędzi.
examples.translation: I still have to check if it's gonna work right, but I can't find the right tools.
examples.english: I still have to check if it's gonna work right, but I can't find the right tools.

examples.text: [...] admini stawiali sobie za punkt honoru żeby w "ich" sieci wszystko banglało ok.
examples.translation: The admins made it a point of pride that everything worked right in their network.
examples.english: The admins made it a point of pride that everything worked right in their network.

examples.text: Wygląda na świetny sprzęt, ale niestety nie bangla w HD :(
examples.translation: It looks like great gear, but unfortunately it doesn't work in HD :(
examples.english: It looks like great gear, but unfortunately it doesn't work in HD :(

examples.text: Ale bangla... Jakby ktoś kubłem lał...
examples.translation: Man is it coming down... Cats and dogs...
examples.english: Man is it coming down... Cats and dogs...

examples.text: [...] za oknem bangla deszcz, w kieszeniu ^([sic]) pusto, w łóżku pusto, nie ma żadnych perspektyw na jakąkolwiek poprawę tej chorej sytuacji...
examples.translation: … the rain is coming down out the window, it's empty in his pocket, the bed too, and there's no way to improve this awful situation...
examples.english: … the rain is coming down out the window, it's empty in his pocket, the bed too, and there's no way to improve this awful situation...

examples.text: Jak naprawde bangla, i tak trzeba przykryć puszkę i szkło foliowym ponczo bo nie nadążysz z wycieraniem przedniej soczewki [...]
examples.translation: It's really coming down hard, and you have to cover the can and glass with a foil poncho because otherwise you won't keep up wiping off the back lenses …
examples.english: It's really coming down hard, and you have to cover the can and glass with a foil poncho because otherwise you won't keep up wiping off the back lenses …
